snippet.title: 8bit Salvage Steam
snippet.description:
Scrub old game art. Save the pixels. Clean through chaos.

8bit Salvage is an incremental cleaning game about a tiny salvage
shop that scrubs retired game sprites for the pixels they're made
of — reclaim the salvage, cash it in, upgrade the shop.

Free demo out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4932590/8bit_Salvage/

Discord: https://discord.gg/eMKJ5U5
X: https://x.com/SoilFertile

A game by Fertile Soil Productions.
